evidence.claim: The final decision from Security and Payments says Tally never stores card numbers or CVCs. Saved cards must use Stripe saved payment methods. This contradicts TAL-65.
TAL-65 has acceptance criteria, but they require saving the card number after the first payment, which is the behavior the decision forbids.

body.why: TAL-65 asks to store card numbers, but the final decision page Decision: we never store card numbers says Tally keeps only the Stripe payment method token. Building it as written would break that decision.
wouldChange: Rewrite TAL-65 to use Stripe saved payment methods and store only the payment method token, in line with the decision page.
Security and Payments formally reverse or amend the decision page Decision: we never store card numbers.

check.reason: Verdict and accepted outcome both verify.
